hypotheses.reconstruction_rule: For each member G####, evaluate the Hermite divided difference of latent F(z)=s(z) on the node list in its operator args; A_i = O_i[F].
required_assumptions: ds denotes the derivative of s with respect to its argument.
Hermite divided differences follow the standard divided-difference recurrence with repeated-node limits.
hypotheses.scientific_rationale: The three non-identical catalog expressions match the first, repeated-node, and second Hermite divided differences of the same latent univariate function s. A single latent function plus node multiplicity explains the structural relations without introducing hidden objects.
